{"version":1,"content":"

MODELS AND NODES USED IN THIS WORKFLOW

 FLUX 3 needs ComfyUI 0.41.0 or newer, the first version with FLUX 3. On an older ComfyUI, Load CLIP has no flux3 type and some nodes show red: update ComfyUI first.

 FLUX 3 needs a free approval first (one time only)

Black Forest Labs keeps the FLUX 3 files behind a short approval on Hugging Face. Until you do it, every FLUX 3 download link below answers "Access to model ... is restricted ... Please log in".

  1. Log in to Hugging Face (a free account).
  2. Open the FLUX 3 model page with the button below and click Agree and access repository. Access is given at once.
  3. Now the download links below work, in the same browser.

FLUX 3 Klein on Hugging Face 

 Downloading with ComfyUI-Manager or a script needs a Hugging Face token as well (hf auth login). In the browser, being logged in is enough.

 Load Diffusion Model

Download flux3-image-klein-int8-convrot.safetensors5.83 GB  

Place in: ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/flux3

Create the flux3 folder if it does not exist.

Take the file WITHOUT base in its name: that is the distilled (fast) model these workflows use. The files with base in the name are the base model, made for training LoRAs: it needs CFG 3.5 and 25 to 50 steps, and at the settings here (15 or 16 steps, CFG 1) its pictures come out smeared and broken.

Already have flux3_image_klein_sd_int8_convrot.safetensors? That is the same file under its first name (ComfyUI's own template used it at launch). Pick it in this node instead of downloading it again.

 Load CLIP

Download qwen3vl_4b_int8_convrot.safetensors4.86 GB  

Place in: ComfyUI/models/text_encoders

 Load VAE

Download flux2-vae.safetensors336 MB  

Place in: ComfyUI/models/vae

The same file as Flux 2 Klein: if you have it, skip this one.

 License

FLUX 3 Image Klein is released under the FLUX Kommunity License. You may use the pictures commercially only while your yearly revenue (all the money coming in, before costs), together with any company you belong to, is under US$5 million. Read it before you use the model for paid work.

FLUX 3 Klein model page 

 After placing the files, restart ComfyUI or refresh model lists using the R shortcut.

 Nodes Installed from Manager

  • Pixaroma: update to the latest version (these workflows need at least 1.4.183). A node shows red or missing? Update Pixaroma.

Which version is the newest? The Latest Pixaroma version button shows it and what is new in it. The help page has the update steps for every kind of install.

Latest Pixaroma version How to update Pixaroma 

 Something missing?

Each button opens a short video that shows the fix, with the steps written under it.

Red or missing nodes A model file is missing Buttons missing after an update 

 Resources

Join Discord  Pixaroma YouTube Channel  Ask for help

{"version":1,"content":"

HOW TO USE

Draw a box on your picture and write what goes in it. FLUX 3 changes only the box area: apart from a soft edge of about 110 px around the box, everything stays exactly your picture. The demo swaps the wicker armchair for a green leather one.

 Steps

  1. Load your picture in Load Image Mini Pixaroma.
  2. On Sketch Pixaroma, delete the demo box, pick the box tool and drag a box around what to change, or around an empty spot where something should go. Make the box the size you want the new thing to be, then type the change in its note: replace the wicker armchair with ... or add a framed painting of ...
  3. Leave the seed on F to repeat a result, or switch it to R to try a new one every Run.
  4. Press Run. Drag across Image Compare Pixaroma to see before and after.

 Writing the note

  • Write it as an instruction, with colour, material and shape: replace the wicker armchair with a dark green leather armchair with rounded arms, a deep buttoned back and short dark wooden legs.
  • Sketch turns the note into the prompt (you can read it on the node): Inside the red box: ... Remove all the colored marks .... FLUX 3 never sees the red box, only the cut-out area, and in our tests that sentence worked exactly as well as a plain prompt.

 How it works

  • The box becomes a mask. Inpaint Crop cuts out the box with some of the picture around it and makes it bigger, FLUX 3 changes only that piece, and Inpaint Stitch pastes it back with a soft edge.
  • Why not give FLUX 3 the picture with the red box drawn on it? We tried: it kept the red box in the result every time.

 Good to know

  • In our tests both jobs worked on every seed: replacing the armchair and adding a painting to the empty wall. The painting often came out a little smaller than its box.
  • On a plain wall the redrawn area can come out a little lighter or warmer and show as a faint patch. This workflow sets softness on Inpaint Stitch to 96, a wide soft edge that hid it in our tests. If a patch still shows, raise the softness, try color_match subtle, or a new seed.
  • Tested with one box per Run.

 Something not working?

Each button opens the answer on the Pixaroma help page.

Save to your own folder Nodes look different from the video

{"version":1,"content":"

WHAT EACH NODE DOES

The colour of a node tells you what kind of node it is. Nothing here needs changing except the blue ones.

 Models to download

Orange. Each one needs a file from the Download Models note.

  • Load Diffusion Model (FLUX 3 Klein, distilled) - The image model, FLUX 3 Image Klein from Black Forest Labs, the distilled version (no base in the file name): 16 steps for an edit, CFG 1. It makes a picture from words AND changes a picture you give it.
  • Load CLIP (Qwen3-VL 4B, reads the prompt) - Reads your prompt and turns the words into something FLUX 3 understands. The type must be flux3.
  • Load VAE (Flux 2 VAE) - Turns the finished render into a picture. FLUX 3 uses the same VAE as Flux 2.

 The steps you set

Blue, and numbered. These are the only nodes you need to touch.

  • Load Image Mini Pixaroma (1. your picture) - The picture to change. Click it to upload your own, or pick one from the list.
  • Sketch Pixaroma (2. draw a box, write the change) - Draw a box around what to change, or around an empty spot where something should go, and write the change in the box's note. Only the box area changes. Its mask output tells Inpaint Crop where the box is; its prompt output is the note, written as an instruction for FLUX 3.
  • Seed Pixaroma (3. fixed or random) - The seed. F (fixed) repeats the result, R (random) tries a new one every Run. The demo uses seed 2.

 The helpers

Purple. They run by themselves and do the small jobs between the steps.

  • Inpaint Crop Pixaroma (cuts out the box area) - Cuts out the box with 96 px of the picture around it, so FLUX 3 sees what surrounds it, and enlarges it to 1024 px on its long side. Leave it as it is. Do not paint in its own mask editor: a mask painted there replaces the box from Sketch.
  • Inpaint Stitch Pixaroma (pastes it back) - Pastes the changed area back into your picture with a wide soft edge (softness 96), so it blends into a plain wall. The soft edge reaches about 110 px past the box; everything farther out is your original picture, pixel for pixel. If a faint patch still shows, raise softness, try color_match subtle, or a new seed.

 The work

Green. They run by themselves.

  • CLIP Text Encode (reads the edit prompt) - Reads the prompt through the text encoder.
  • ConditioningZeroOut (empty negative) - An empty negative prompt. FLUX 3 distilled runs at CFG 1, where the negative does nothing, but the KSampler still needs one plugged in.
  • Set Reference Multi Latent (the cut-out area) - Hands the cut-out area to FLUX 3 as the picture to change, for the prompt and for the empty negative. Set to resize, 1 megapixel. It also gives the KSampler its blank canvas, the shape of the cut-out area.
  • KSampler (16 steps) - The edit: 16 steps, CFG 1, euler, simple, the settings of Black Forest Labs' own FLUX 3 Klein distilled edit workflow.
  • VAE Decode (latent to picture) - Turns the finished render into a picture.

 The result

Dark red, at the end.

  • Save Image Pixaroma (saves the result) - Saves each result as PNG into ComfyUI/output/Flux 3 Klein Box Edit and shows it on the node.
  • Image Compare Pixaroma (before and after, drag across it) - Your picture and the result on top of each other. Drag across it: only the box area changes.

 Readouts

Dark. Nothing to set: they show you what happened.

  • Run Timer - The dark clock above the result shows how long the last Run took.

{"version":1,"content":"

RUN TIMES

Measured on a 24 GB RTX 4090 with this workflow, with the models already loaded. A different card gives different numbers, but the shape holds: the time grows with the number of pictures and their size.

WhatTime
One box edit (the cut-out area at about 1 megapixel)about 4.5 s

 The first Run of the session

The first Run after starting ComfyUI also has to load the models from disk (FLUX 3 and its text encoder, about 11 GB together), so it takes longer. After that they stay loaded.

","buttonColor":"#f66744","lineColor":"#f66744","backgroundColor":"#2a2a2a","info":{"title":"Run Times","icon":"run-timer","color":"#3f9a4f"}}
